market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham is an established mid-table Premier League club with solid financial backing and a squad capable of finishing above the relegation zone. Historical relegation probabilities for similar clubs typically range between 10–20%, making a 34.5% market price excessively pessimistic. Even if the current 2024–25 season is difficult, relegation next season is not the most likely outcome.
evidence_points: West Ham has not been relegated since returning to the Premier League in 2012–13 and consistently finishes in the bottom half but above the drop zone.
The club has invested in high-quality players like Bowen and Paquetá and appointed Graham Potter, suggesting ambition to stay stable.
Pre-season relegation odds for 2024–25 implied a ~12% probability, far lower than the 34.5% currently offered, indicating market overreaction to short-term form.
